title: Learner 01 | Day 025: Identity, equality, copying, and hashing
body:
## Goal

Compare equal Session records, inspect shallow copies of nested lists, and reject a mutable list as a dictionary key.

## Implementation contract

**File:** `src/learnforge/adapters/connections/session_models.py`

**Method/unit:** `handle_session_identity`

**Why here:** This translates an external representation or service: raw input, HTTP/provider/protocol behavior, and error translation belong outside the core.

**Inputs and expected outputs:** Equal lists can have different identities; shallow-copy mutation of a nested item affects both outer lists.

**Boundaries:** Own parsing/transport only; delegate domain decisions and storage.

## Research hints

1. Research **Identity, equality, copying, and hashing**. Which rule explains your named unit’s behavior?
2. Search `site:docs.python.org Identity equality copying and hashing`; use [Python tutorial](https://docs.python.org/3.13/tutorial/) for the relevant small section.
3. Predict one changed input/timing case, run it, and explain each changed value before applying the finding.

## Done

- [ ] Demonstrate this unit’s normal and boundary/failure cases in the working feature.
- [ ] Show the actual run and explain one changed case using concrete values.

**Question of the Day:** Can a function annotated int still receive a string at runtime?

**Review with @GlidingScorpion:** run the named unit; show actual output and each relevant line’s purpose, before/after values and project contribution.
